safetensors_metadata.detail: header-only floating dtype distribution; no tensor payloads downloaded

nemo_model_config.detail: streamed from the .nemo tar; canonical for frontend/tokenizer/encoder/decoder/joint and the speaker-kernel additions

key_fields.encoder.type: Cache-Aware FastConformer (chunked_limited attention + chunked causal convs) + speaker-kernel injection
key_fields.multitalker.external_diar_model: nvidia/diar_streaming_sortformer_4spk-v2.1 (Streaming Sortformer; embedded in the optional bundle GGUF artifacts)

dtype.evidence: NeMo .nemo archive ships the model as a float32 PyTorch state_dict (no safetensors), consistent with every parakeet-family variant in this repo including the base nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b it is fine-tuned from.

upstream_benchmarks.notes: Single-speaker-mode ASR path (multitalker disabled). This is the LibriSpeech-comparable English acceptance target for a first port. whisper-normalizer PnC-stripped scoring, same as the base model.
Single-speaker mode. Base nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b is 7.16; the multitalker fine-tune preserves single-speaker performance (+0.28 avg).

metric=cpWER (concatenated minimum-permutation WER). The accepted bundle path embeds the Sortformer diarizer and runs per-speaker streaming instances. Measured AMI-IHM F32 cpWER is 19.35% in kernel mode and 23.73% in masked mode; the matched NeMo reference scores 21.39% and 24.00%. NVIDIA also reports AMI-SDM 37.44, CH109 15.81, and Mixer6 23.81.

reference_rationale: NVIDIA NeMo first-party framework. Same rationale as the rest of the parakeet family and the base model it is fine-tuned from, nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b: the HF repo ships only a `.nemo` tar archive (consumable by nemo.collections.asr.models.ASRModel.from_pretrained) plus helper scripts; there is no Transformers modeling class and no safetensors. The class is EncDecMultiTalkerRNNTBPEModel. The multitalker oracle is NeMo's `examples/asr/asr_cache_aware_streaming/speech_to_text_multitalker_streaming_infer.py` plus the SpeakerTaggedASR helper in `nemo.collections.asr.parts.utils.multispk_transcribe_utils` and the shipped `multitalker_transcript_config.py`. The multitalker path requires the separate nvidia/diar_streaming_sortformer_4spk-v2.1 checkpoint; canonical bundle GGUFs embed that diarizer, while plain GGUFs retain single_speaker_mode behavior. The base ASR backbone (frontend, cache-aware FastConformer encoder, RNN-T decoder/joint, tokenizer) is byte-for-byte the same shape as the already-ported nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b.
known_risks: MULTITALKER core mechanism (speaker-kernel injection). The checkpoint adds a learnable speaker kernel of type `ff` at encoder layer 0 (`spk_kernel_layers=[0]`) plus a background-speaker kernel (`add_bg_spk_kernel=true`). The accepted runtime exports those tensors, accepts per-frame target/background supervision from the embedded diarizer, and applies both residual injections in NeMo order. This remains the central architecture-specific numerical risk.

EXTERNAL diarization dependency. Multitalker/speaker-attributed ASR requires nvidia/diar_streaming_sortformer_4spk-v2.1, a separate NEST/Sortformer checkpoint. Canonical bundle GGUFs pin and embed that model so users cannot accidentally pair separate files; plain GGUFs intentionally expose only single_speaker_mode.

MULTI-INSTANCE orchestration. The model runs one cache-aware encoder/decoder state per active speaker (up to four). The accepted runtime gates instances per chunk from the embedded diarizer, keeps per-speaker working state constant in clip length, and merges the outputs; whole-call input, mel, and diarizer-prediction storage remains linear in clip duration.

OUTPUT contract. Multitalker output is exposed through the existing structured result ABI: transcript segments carry 1-based speaker_id values, words link to their segment, and transcript-independent speaker turns are available through speaker-segment rows. The incremental public streaming API remains single-speaker; multitalker currently runs through transcribe_run.

single_speaker_mode remains the LibriSpeech-comparable path. Plain GGUFs and bundle GGUFs with diarization disabled behave as cache-aware streaming RNN-T models (LS test-clean 2.19 / test-other 4.76) with the checkpoint's always-on all-ones speaker-kernel and zero-background injection.

Encoder attention is chunked_limited (carried from the base). att_context_style='chunked_limited', att_context_size menu [[70,13],[70,6],[70,1],[70,0]] in 80ms frames, default [70,13] = 1.12s latency. Frames are grouped into chunks of R+1 and each chunk sees itself + floor(L/(R+1)) prior chunks; this is NOT a per-frame sliding window. Already implemented for nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b; reuse verbatim.

Chunked causal depthwise convolutions (carried from the base). conv_context_size='causal', causal_downsampling=true. Per-chunk causal conv with state carried across chunks; in one-shot mode the state zero-inits but the causal pattern must still be applied. Already handled by the existing cache-aware parakeet code.

Frontend has NO normalization and NO preemphasis (carried from the base, confirmed from model_config.yaml: normalize='NA'). Differs from every non-streaming parakeet variant (which use preemphasis=0.97 + per_feature norm). The converter must emit the 'no frontend normalization' GGUF KV and the C++ frontend must skip per-feature norm; a silent fall-through degrades WER without changing shapes. Already handled for nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b.

RNN-T backbone is identical to nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b: 24L / d=1024 / 8h / kernel=9 / dw_striding x8 / subsampling_conv_channels=256, RNNTDecoder 2x640, RNNTJoint 640 (no duration head, joint.durations=None), BPE vocab 1024 with blank at 1024, PnC in vocab. The speaker-kernel tensors and multitalker orchestration are the variant-specific additions.
WER normalization: whisper-normalizer (PnC strip + lowercase + NFC + number norm) on both hyp and ref, same as the base model, required for the single-speaker LibriSpeech numbers to be comparable.
License: NVIDIA Open Model License (not Apache-2.0), same as the base. Affects the Stage 8 HF card YAML.
